title: Welcome to the Hover API
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://developers.hover.to/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

The Hover API provides a powerful and flexible interface for integrating property data and workflows directly into your existing business systems. It allows you to programmatically create and manage jobs, initiate property captures, retrieve precise 3D models and comprehensive measurement data (including various JSON, PDF, XLSX, SKP, ESX, and XML formats), receive real-time status updates via webhooks, and manage organizational resources like inspection workflows and wallets. By leveraging Hover's API, businesses can automate key processes, enhance data accuracy, streamline operations, and build richer applications that utilize Hover's 3D property intelligence.

# 🚀 What’s New   [Skip link to 🚀 What’s New](https://developers.hover.to/docs/welcome\#-whats-new)

Stay up to date with the latest updates to the Hover API! Below are newly released endpoints, guides, and features:

* * *

## 📅 **Fall 2026**   [Skip link to 📅 ,[object Object]](https://developers.hover.to/docs/welcome\#--fall-2026)

### 📄 New: Estimate Order Documents (PDF & CSV)   [Skip link to 📄 New: Estimate Order Documents (PDF & CSV)](https://developers.hover.to/docs/welcome\#-new-estimate-order-documents-pdf--csv)

Generate Material List and Work Order documents from any Estimate. [See endpoints](https://developers.hover.to/reference/estimate-order-documents-pdf-csv).

### 🤝 New: Marketplace Integration Application   [Skip link to 🤝 New: Marketplace Integration Application](https://developers.hover.to/docs/welcome\#-new-marketplace-integration-application)

New Marketplace integrations now start with a short [partner application](https://developers.hover.to/docs/prerequisites-for-creating-a-marketplace-integration), so our team has time to support every partner well. Custom integrations are unchanged.

### ✍️ New: Agreements Workflows   [Skip link to ✍️ New: Agreements Workflows](https://developers.hover.to/docs/welcome\#%EF%B8%8F-new-agreements-workflows)

Pull Agreements into your system when they're created or signed. [See the guide](https://developers.hover.to/docs/agreements-integrations).

### 🏘️ Multi-Structure and Multi-Level Workflow Support   [Skip link to 🏘️ Multi-Structure and Multi-Level Workflow Support](https://developers.hover.to/docs/welcome\#%EF%B8%8F-multi-structure-and-multi-level-workflow-support)

We’ve enhanced our platform to allow the capture of:

- Multiple structures within a single property (job)
- Multiple levels within a single structure

New **v3 API endpoints** and **webhook events** now support these use cases.
